page_description: Address verification and autocomplete, apps that validate carts, and rules on the shipping address and the cart: an error stops checkout with your message under the field, a warning only shows it.
rules_no_access_title: Your role can't see checkout rules
rules_no_access_description: Ask the store owner for the checkout_rules:read scope.
rules_description: Evaluated on every change to a cart, in this order. At most 100.
rules_empty_description: Refuse PO boxes for couriers, require a house number or a phone, keep address lines short for labels: start from a preset.
rule_delete_description: Carts stop showing its message at once.
preset_dialog_subtitle: Start from a preset; everything can be changed before you save.
preset_no_po_boxes_description: For every option, or only couriers that can't deliver to them.
preset_no_military_description: APO, FPO and DPO addresses, which only the postal service delivers to.
preset_house_number_description: The first address line must have a number (the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium).
preset_phone_required_description: For the shipping options whose carrier calls ahead.
preset_line_length_description: What UPS and FedEx print on a label.
preset_canary_islands_title: No Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla
preset_canary_islands_description: Spanish postal codes outside the EU's VAT area.
preset_undeliverable_description: When the verification app finds no such address.
new_description: Pick what must hold, and what the shopper is told.
condition_field_not_matches: A field doesn't match a pattern
summary_field_longer_than: {field} is longer than {length, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
summary_field_shorter_than: {field} is shorter than {length, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
summary_chosen_products: {count, plural, one {# chosen product} other {# chosen products}}
summary_weight_at_least: What's shipped weighs at least {grams} g
summary_weight_below: What's shipped weighs less than {grams} g
editor_name_description: For staff; shoppers see the message.
editor_enabled_description: Off: carts don't show it, and the test below still tries it.
editor_shipping_options_description: Chosen: only while the shopper has one of them chosen, and the message shows under the options.
editor_conditions_description: All of them must hold. A condition on the address waits until the shopper enters one.
editor_pattern_description: A regular expression, like \bbox\b. It may match anywhere in the field.
editor_text_description: One per line; case doesn't matter.
editor_region_codes_description: One per line, as the address form stores them: CA, NY, M.
editor_verdicts_description: Needs a verification app; without one, no verdict holds.
editor_categories_description: A product in a category below one counts too.
editor_amounts_hint: One amount per currency; a cart in a currency left empty doesn't match.
editor_message_description: Plain text, shown under the field. Say what to do.
editor_code_description: For storefronts and apps: snake_case, like po_box_not_allowed. Empty is rule.
try_description: What a cart would show with this rule as it is in the form, beside your other enabled rules and the address's format. Nothing is saved.
try_verify_description: Its verdict and flags, for rules that read them. Costs a lookup.
try_refused_title: A cart would refuse this address
try_no_messages: No messages: checkout would go on.
app_verification_description: An app that checks whether mail reaches a shipping address and suggests a corrected one. Shoppers see a warning and the suggestion; add a rule on the verdict to stop checkout.
app_verification_empty: No installed app verifies addresses. Install one whose manifest declares address.verify.
app_autocomplete_description: An app that suggests addresses as people type the first line, in the storefront's checkout and account and in the admin's address forms. Picking one fills the form.
app_autocomplete_empty: No installed app suggests addresses. Install one whose manifest declares address.suggest and address.resolve.
validation_description: Apps that check a cart as the shopper goes: when the address is set, when an option is chosen and at checkout. Their errors stop checkout and their warnings show under the field. At most five.
validation_empty: No installed app validates checkouts. Install one whose manifest declares checkout.validate and is granted carts:read.
validation_column_block: Block checkout when this app fails
